arabic text: QASIM TERI QURBANI PAY, RAB KI RAZA ROTI RAHI\nTERI YAEEMI DEKH KAR, KHAAKE SHIFA ROTI RAHI
english translation text: QASIM’S SACRIFICE QASIM ON YOUR SACRIFICE, THE LORD’ CRIED IN PLEASURE\nLOOKING AT YOU BEING AN ORPHAN, THE SAND OF KARBALA CRIED

arabic text: TUKDE HUWA LASHA TERA, QASIM YATEEM-E-MUJTABA\nMATAM KIYA SAADAT NE, KARB-O-BALA ROTI RAHI
english translation text: THE SAYYEDS MOURNED, KARBALA CRIED\nIN PIECES YOUR BODY LAY, QASIM THE ORPHAN OF MUJTABA

arabic text: RO RO KE KARTI THI FUGHAAN, MARA GAYA QASIM JAWAN\nKARBOBALA KE DASHT MAI, MAA KI SADA ROTI RAHI
english translation text: SHE MOURNED AND CALLED OUT, QASIM HAS BEEN SLAIN\nON THE PLAINS OF KARBALA HIS MOTHER CRIED

arabic text: GHORE SE JAB QASIM GIRA, TAKSEEM JAB LAASHA HUWA\nKHAIMON ME THAA MAATAM BAPA, AALE ABA ROTI RAHI
english translation text: WHEN QASIM FELL FROM HIS HORSE, HIS BODY WAS TRAMPLED\nTHERE WAS MOURNING IN THE TENTS, THE FAMILY OF THE CLOAK CRIED

arabic text: FARWA KE DIL ME AAS THI, DEKHUNGI QASIM KI KHUSHI\nGHATRI MAI LASHA DEKH KAR, MA KI DUA ROTI RAHI
english translation text: BIBI FARWA HAD HOPES OF SEEING QASIM HAPPY\nWHEN SHE SAW THE PIECES OF HIS BODY, THOSE HOPES WERE LOST

arabic text: LARZI ZAMEEN KAMPA FALAK, QASIM HUWA PAAMAL JAB\nJAWWAD SIR KO PEET KAR, RANME QAZA ROTI RAHI
english translation text: THE EARTH TREMBLED, THE SKY SHOOK WHEN QASIM WAS TRAMPLED UPON\nJAWWAD (POET) BEATING ITS HEAD, CRIED AT THIS BOYS FATE
